subject: EUBank onboarding — request for IRP, SOC 2/SIG artifacts and log samples
messages:
From: Alexis Dupont <alexis.dupont@eubank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-eu@eubank.com; Lars Jensen <lars.jensen@eubank.com>
Date: 2026-04-30T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Onboarding — IRP and SOC2/SIG artifacts needed for review

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the kickoff earlier this week. As part of EUBank's security onboarding we need a short package to complete our intake:

- The company Incident Response Plan (IRP) you will follow for EUBank scope (high level + escalation contacts).
- A SIG/Catalog mapping showing which controls map to our in-scope requirements.
- Recent sample telemetry (redacted) demonstrating authentication/authorization events and retention policy.
- Any SOC 2 audit summary and the date of the last audit (if available).

Can we get the artifacts by end of day today? If you can’t provide everything, please send what you have and we’ll mark remaining items as "in progress".

Also confirm whether you will accept our standard redaction form (attached) — we need to agree on what can be shared.

Appreciate the help — happy to hop on a quick call if it speeds things up.

Best,
Alexis
Security Ops Lead
EUBank

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alexis Dupont <alexis.dupont@eubank.com>
Date: 2026-04-30T09:05:00+01:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding — IRP and SOC2/SIG artifacts needed for review

Team — forwarding EUBank request. They want the IRP, SIG mapping, a SOC2 summary and a redacted telemetry sample by EOD. Can each of you own the pieces below?

- Marissa: assemble the IRP + SOC2 summary and generate a short cover note explaining the last audit date and scope. Include contact for escalation.
- Karthik: export a small telemetry sample (auth events only) and prepare redaction notes; ensure no PII or customer tokens. Zip with checksums.
- Soojin: review the SIG mapping and confirm which controls we can map to EUBank’s listed requirements; flag anything we need to push for a PO or carve-out.

If we can’t meet EOD for all items, get what we have and mark the remainder as "deliverable within 48h" in the reply. I will be the sender back to EUBank to maintain a single thread.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate packaging into Drive and share links.

Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance (on interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-30T11:18:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding — IRP and SOC2/SIG artifacts needed for review

Irene / team — quick status:

- IRP_Redwood_v2.1.pdf attached (internal IRP trimmed to high-level customer-facing scope). Contains incident lifecycle, primary/secondary escalation contacts, and typical timelines for containment/forensics/notification.
- SOC2 summary: we completed Type II FY25 (period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Summary page included in the IRP appendix; full report is under NDA — we can initiate a limited-access share if EUBank needs the report.
- Cover note will be in the Drive link I will post in the reply to Alexis.

Two notes:
1) The IRP references some internal forensics tooling names — I redacted tooling endpoints and replaced them with role descriptions per our redaction guidance (see redaction_instructions.txt).
2) We will need EUBank to sign the limited-access NDA to see the full SOC2 report; otherwise the summary should suffice for intake.

Attaching: IRP_Redwood_v2.1.pdf, redaction_instructions.txt

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alexis Dupont <alexis.dupont@eubank.com>
Date: 2026-04-30T12:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding — IRP and SOC2/SIG artifacts needed for review

Alexis / Irene / Marissa — attaching telemetry sample (telemetry_sample_202604.zip). Contents: a CSV of auth success/failure events (last 7 days), timestamps in UTC, and a short README explaining fields. I scrubbed token identifiers and user email addresses per the redaction instructions and replaced them with hashed ids.

A couple of technical clarifications for EUBank:
- Retention: auth events are kept at 90 days in cold storage, 7 days hot. We can provide extended retention samples under a data access agreement.
- Logs include internal service labels; if you need a mapping file for those labels -> let us know and we will provide a document separately.

If EUBank needs sample with IP aggregation instead of hashed ids, specify the exact columns they require.

Karthik Iyer
Senior SRE, Observability
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexis Dupont <alexis.dupont@eubank.com>, security-eu@eubank.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-30T14:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding — IRP and SOC2/SIG artifacts needed for review

Alexis — thanks for the patience. Attached and shared via Drive:
- IRP_Redwood_v2.1.pdf (high-level customer IRP)
- SOC2_SIG_Mapping_EUBank.xlsx (control crosswalk to SIG + notes on scope)
- telemetry_sample_202604.zip (auth events, redacted)
- redaction_instructions.txt (what we removed and why)

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.redwoodinference.com/shared/EUBank_onboarding/IRP_v2.1

A few quick points to make reviewing easier:
- SOC2: summary provided in the IRP appendix. Full Type II report can be made available under our standard limited access NDA; please confirm if EUBank legal wants that.
- SIG mapping: we flagged three items requiring EUBank input (tabs named "policy_clarify"). One is around isolated dev/test datasets — Soojin, see the highlighted row.
- Telemetry: hashed_user_id is the substitute for PII; if you need a canonical mapping for incident drill purposes, we can discuss a tightly-scoped mapping mechanism.

If you'd like a 30-minute review call to walk through the artifacts and answer questions, I'm available today 16:00-17:00 CET or tomorrow morning.

Best regards,

Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance (interim)
Redwood Inference

--
Forwarded-For-Record: JIRA-SEC-4921 (onboarding intake)
Attachments: IRP_Redwood_v2.1.pdf (PDF), SOC2_SIG_Mapping_EUBank.xlsx (XLSX), telemetry_sample_202604.zip (ZIP), redaction_instructions.txt (TXT)
